notes.title: Update 1.1 is here / 30% off this week
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Rolling Sun Update 1.1 is there.
Adding new challenge in which you will discover the beauty of a mountain waterfall during a perilous ascent.
And a new branch in the main menu and correction / optimization of many game mechanics.

Many of you were to ask for an additional level. It's done! take a look at "Ascension"

[img]http://nsa37.casimages.com/img/2015/08/10/150810083030703324.jpg[/img][img]http://nsa38.casimages.com/img/2015/08/10/150810083029727595.jpg[/img]

Rolling Sun will be discounted to -30% during the week of 11/9 to 11/15!
If you love physical games and skill, it's time to play Rolling Sun!

Update 1.1 details:

-Added Level "Ultime Ascension".
-Added A new branch to the main menu.
-Added Several notifications and tips.
-Added Light effects.
-Added Fog.

-Improved Physics on the ball.
-Improved controlls with the joystick.
-Improved Physics gameplay elements.

-Fixed Texture bug "Replace me".
-Fixed Runway edges.
-Fixed Some proxy.
